violation_type.title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))
violation_type.short_title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the information available during the investigation inspection, sufficient evidence was available to support the facility did not have a menu posted.

finding_variants.text: Based on the information available during the investigation inspection, sufficient evidence was available to support the facility did not have a menu posted.
The operation did not have a menu posted.
The last available menu was dated for September 2023.
The menu posted on the main board with all the required postings was outdated it was from August of 2023.     Corrected at inspection: The recent menu was posted.
The operation did not have a menu posted. This was corrected when a menu for the week was printed and posted.
